title: CommitSmith Codex CLI Fix Response (v1)
description: Describes the expected unified diff payload returned by the Codex CLI when generating AI fixes. Increment the .vN suffix in both file name and schema id whenever the structure changes.

diff.description: Unified diff applying the requested fix.

meta.description: Optional metadata about the generated patch.

producedBy.description: Identifier describing the agent or workflow that produced the patch.

step.description: Pipeline step associated with this patch.
